name: PT Multitrend Indo Tbk
summary: PT Multitrend Indo Tbk is an Indonesian enterprise specializing in the retail provision of apparel, accessories, and playthings for infants and young children. The company conducts its sales through both conventional physical outlets and its e-commerce platform. Established in 2005, its main offices are located in Jakarta Pusat, Indonesia. PT Multitrend Indo Tbk operates as a part of PT Kanmo Retailindo.
